notes.title: Map Editor, Incantations & Blood FX
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The latest update is live — and it’s meaty. Whether you're here to sculpt chaos from the ground up or simply want your explosions bloodier and louder, there’s plenty waiting for you. Let’s dive in.

[b]Map Editor: Now in Your Hands (Experimental)[/b]
That’s right — the Map Editor is here!

You can now create, play, and share your own maps. Place enemies, weapons, pickups, and more. Want to build a tightly packed corridor brawl? A wide open arena filled with flamethrowers and trap clusters? Go wild.

⚠️ The Map Editor is still experimental — expect rough edges and frequent updates as we shape this into a core tool for the community. We can’t wait to see what you make.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328413/c1c2e24bf14ec2633c6b1089f2683a095b93d0cf.gif[/img]

Key features:
[list]
[*] Tools to place and move Map Blocks, Weapons, Enemy Spawners and Traps.
[*] Inspector Panel - Tweak properties of placed objects
[*] Test map - Test your map directly inside the editor.
[*] Mod.io - Download maps from Mod.IO to play other players' creations.
[/list]

[b]New Incantation Synergies[/b]
The Fury of the Burning Star (ignited effects) and Pact of the Burning Star (flamed effects) sets now offer unique synergies when used together. These sets now have more depth, allowing you to fine-tune your build with meaningful choices and trade-offs.

[i]Play around with combinations and find a setup that fits your playstyle.[/i]


[b]Blood VFX Overhaul[/b]
You asked. We bled.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328413/5974991a03c5cdbe5e9739dc2822a8b068f9a718.gif[/img]

The blood system has been fully reworked with:
[list]
[*] New splat decals
[*] Persistent gore
[*] More juice, more style
[/list]
Whether you're hacking, shooting, or flamethrowering your way through the map — it’s gonna get messy (in the best way).

[b]Also in This Update[/b]
[list]
[*] New font type for better character support.
[*] Balancing of Flamethrower DPS.
[*] Bugs and fixes
[/list]
As always, keep the feedback and bug reports coming — the creativity and chaos you bring to the world never cease to amaze us. Keep building. Keep shooting. Keep casting. And above all — keep it bloody.

See you in the editor!

— The Dev Team 🔥

notes.title: The Flames Rise – Update Now Live
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328413/82b64013331d84a1354db6f1b881faf84edfc95c.png[/img]

Hello wanderers,
A new update has arrived, bringing sweeping changes to gameplay, combat, and the horrors you face beyond the veil.

🔮 [b]Incantation System Overhaul[/b]
The arcane arts have evolved. This update introduces a complete rework of the incantation system, featuring 20+ unique incantations that now interact directly with your loadout and character stats. Want to imbue your weapon with scorching embers or boost your speed with blood rituals? You can — if you dare.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328413/350e86125670316b9b5f99ed8659cb8bf12f3f38.gif[/img]

🔥 [b]Flamethrower Added[/b]
The new flamethrower is built for devastation. Engulf multiple enemies at once and leave blazing patches of fire in your wake. It’s a tool of chaos—and exactly what you’ll need for what’s coming next.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328413/59c635d0150cdc16878d3e0368b7be01dfbf4245.gif[/img]

🐙 [b]The Deep One Reawakens[/b]
A familiar terror has returned, reborn. The Deep One in Act 2 has been fully reimagined: it’s larger and more vicious. It doesn’t just emerge—it erupts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328413/3a326f61b983eaa6ee433f7a4a2d9823acd17152.gif[/img]

⚖️ [b]Game Balance Improvements[/b]
We’ve also implemented balance tweaks across the board, tuning enemy behavior, weapon damage curves, and resource scaling. These changes aim to enhance the tension without tipping into frustration.

As always, thank you for playing, testing, and giving us the feedback that shapes this world.
See you in the fire.

— The Dev Team 🔥

notes.title: Update: Unlocking Meta Progression!
notes.content:
Our latest update for Cthulhu’s Reach: Devil Reef has arrived! This update introduces a host of new features to enrich your experience, including a revamped Meta Progression system, an expanded Diary, and a new weapon unlock system in the Hut. Let’s dive into the details!

[b]Meta Progression[/b]
Weapons you’ve unlocked in the Diary now appear on the Hut’s weapon wall, ready for selection. Instead of relying on random drops, you’ll gather a rare new resource — [i]Dagonite [/i]— and trade it for new weapons within the your Diary. This system allows you to assemble your arsenal before setting out, granting greater strategic control and ensuring you're fully prepared for the nightmares that await.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328413/d3a800a3e438a18740b71627966a0fd3bd041e4e.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328413/c024ecfd6404945874c86057dd38c37584c125b7.gif[/img]

[b]Your Diary Unlocked[/b]
Your personal Diary is now accessible mid-run and now includes a Journal. As you encounter eldritch monstrosities, you’ll unlock detailed entries revealing their weaknesses, behaviors, and lore. The deeper you delve into Devil Reef’s mysteries, the more knowledge you’ll gain—knowledge that just might keep you alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328413/8eb0906383bb759edb1b4c66853a36336e3348d7.gif[/img]

[b]New Weapon Upgrade System[/b]
Experience a new way to upgrade your chosen weapons. Fine-tune their attributes to gain crucial advantages, ensuring you’re prepared to face the horrors lurking beneath the waves.

[b]Graphic Settings[/b]
You can now switch between different resolutions, refresh rates, and choose between windowed or exclusive fullscreen mode to tailor the experience to your needs.

This update also brings balance adjustments, UI improvements, and bug fixes for a smoother gameplay experience. We’d love to hear your feedback—join the discussion in our forums or on Discord!

Good luck, and may the Great Old Ones spare your sanity… for now.

notes.title: Update 0.60 - Eldritch Control: Rebinding & Glyphs Unveiled
notes.content:
Greetings, Seekers of the Eldritch Truth,

Prepare yourselves for the latest revelations brought forth in version 0.60. With gameplay and UX refinements, your journey into madness continues to evolve. Here are the sinister details:

[h2]Gameplay[/h2] [list]
[*] [b]Controls Rebinding:[/b] Players can now rebind controls, allowing for more customized gameplay.
[*] [b]Dynamic Glyphs:[/b] Dynamic action binding glyphs are now available and updated with active controller device (Keyboard&Mouse/Xbox/PlayStation). (IMPORTANT! Disable Steam input if using a PlayStation controller to avoid interference.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328413/d96690539fb6fd92168dea9a43172a48afb90414.png[/img]
[*] [b]The Innsmouth Man Interrupted:[/b] Innsmouth Man’s attack is now interrupted if he is damaged during his animation.
[*] [b]Enhanced Combat Feedback:[/b] Enemies now give better audio feedback when successfully hit, making combat more visceral.
[*] [b]Player Movement Pause:[/b] The player now pauses movement during attacks, requiring more strategic planning.
[*] [b]Know Your Nemesis:[/b] Upon death, the window now shows your killer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328413/1e9829ee2f13843b8ab282136815f7c62b3a31f3.png[/img]
[*] [b]HUD Improvements:[/b] Centralized HUD bar visibility utilizing new game states. Any open windows now close when the level is completed.
[*] [b]Steam Deck Support:[/b] Added support for Steam Deck’s floating gamepad text input, making interactions smoother.
[*] [b]Yuggothic Ooze Charge Attack:[/b] The Yuggothic Ooze enemy now charges and dashes with new sound effects and improved attack logic.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328413/4c2fe8587a66e101192900d5395b6243bdaebb49.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Tommy Gun Improvements:[/b] The Tommy Gun sound effects have been enhanced with a more pronounced thump to let the others know that your coming for them.
[*] [b]Menu Pause:[/b] To help your lonesome endeavors the game now pauses while navigating in-run menu or choosing incantation during solo play.
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2] [list]
[*] [b]HUD Stability:[/b] Resolved issues where HUD elements didn’t update properly after death or level completion.
[*] [b]Watchers' Bugfixes:[/b] Fixed multiple issues with The Watcher, including a “spin to win” bug and a death sequence that didn’t open doors.
[*] [b]Deep One Bullets Despawn:[/b] Deep One Bullets now correctly despawn when retrying run.
[*] [b]Cutscene Skipping:[/b] Fixed an issue preventing players from skipping cutscenes correctly.
[*] [b]Nav Mesh Fixes:[/b] Resolved an issue preventing enemies from generating a nav mesh agent during certain states.
[*] [b]UI Fixes:[/b] Improved button selections, exit actions, and ensured smoother HUD functionality when using gamepads or keyboard.
[*] [b]And more, hidden in the depth of the abyss...[/b]
[/list]

May these new additions and fixes aid you in your descent into the abyss. The Great Old Ones continue to watch your every move, expecting nothing short of perfection.

Tread carefully, and may the whispers of the void guide you,

- Daniel & Per at The Fine Arc

notes.title: Update 0.50.22 Unleashed!
notes.content:
Greetings, intrepid adventurers and seekers of the arcane,

Your humble developers at The Fine Arc are both thrilled and unnerved to unveil the latest update to Cthulhu's Reach: Devil Reef.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[h3]Act 1: Refinements of Old[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Arena of Despair:[/b] The boss battle arena has been reimagined, designed to amplify both terror and tactical acumen.
[*] [b]Melodies of Dread:[/b] As you face the monstrous guardian of the eldritch depth, let the haunting strains of new boss battle music envelop you.
[previewyoutube=4hp86mx_0ng;full][/previewyoutube]

[*] [b]Visual Clarity Amidst Chaos:[/b] The very fabric of the Act 1 environment has been refined. Floors and walls now stand distinct, guiding your path through the labyrinthine madness with greater clarity, reminiscent of the dreaded streets and cellars of Innsmouth.
[/list]
[h3]Act 2: A Descent into New Abysses[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Lava-Flows and Treacherous Bridges:[/b] Traverse landscapes adorned with flowing lava, coral, and fungi. Tread upon precarious bridges where each step could spell doom!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328413/9d02cba4717dcc4605c8cba8bf61233d8e060f34.gif[/img]
[h3]Encounters Redefined[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Unpredictable Malevolence:[/b] Enemy spawning mechanics have been overhauled for a more balanced experience.
[*] [b]Combat Fluidity:[/b] Your movement speed now diminishes whilst attacking, demanding a more strategic approach to battle.
[*] [b]Boomstick Enhancement:[/b] The Boomstick now cleaves through multiple foes in sweeping arcs, as intended from the factory — a formidable weapon against the relentless assaults of the deep ones.
[*] [b]Boss Fortitude:[/b] The boss has been imbued with greater health, ensuring it presents a challenge worthy of your skills.
[*] [b]The Veil is Lifted:[/b] The health of your latest target now manifests atop your screen, a fleeting yet crucial revelation. Know your enemy's vitality and strike with calculated precision!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328413/9f128b49959e63a89ad70941956e2728d37c288e.gif[/img]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Audio Resolutions:[/b] Audio volume settings now persist as intended, ensuring an uninterrupted auditory experience.
[*] [b]Health Synchronization:[/b] The health of remote players updates correctly, maintaining the integrity of multiplayer engagements.
[*] Adjusted barrel knockback to be less overpowering.
[*] and more...
[/list]

We thank you, [i]brave souls[/i], for your unwavering support and continued journey into the unknown. As you venture forth, remember to stay vigilant and tread carefully, for the shadows are long, and the depths are full of terrors.

Yours in perpetual dread,
Per & Daniel at The Fine Arc

notes.title: Update 0.47 - Eldritch Equilibrium: Stats, Health & Damage Overhaul
notes.content:
Greetings, Intrepid Seekers of the Unknown,

Prepare yourselves for an update that delves deeper into the arcane mechanics of our game, bringing forth new balances and refinements that echo the maddening precision of the Great Old Ones themselves. Here are the forbidden secrets uncovered in this latest update:
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Damage Precision:[/b] Damage and health values have been scaled to allow for more granular increments, ensuring better balancing possibilities in the future.
[*] [b]Weapon Unveiling:[/b] Unlocked weapons now manifest upon the ground at the beginning of each level, awaiting your grasp.
[*] [b]Eldritch Evasion:[/b] Players can now dodge to extinguish flames, a vital skill in evading fiery doom.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328413/07b3803240304d9a44f4f570784c05a256315aaf.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Stats Clarity:[/b] The stats have been aligned to provide more logical values, allowing you to gauge their effects with greater clarity.
[*] [b]No More Mimics:[/b] Removes chest from beach, just to be safe...
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where the book would remain open if a run ended with it open.
[*] Fixed a bug allowing players to jump outside the level boundaries.
[*] Corrected an issue where the incantation button was auto-selected when using a keyboard.
[*] The mouse no longer ghostly hovers buttons, preventing unintended interactions.
[*] The upgrade button is now hidden on the client when there isn't enough gold, preventing false hope.
[/list]
[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*] The feedback button now present an opt-in before leaving the game and links directly to the Steam forum for communal discourse.
[/list]

May these changes serve you well as you navigate the eldritch horrors that await. Your journey into the unknown continues to evolve, guided by the whispers of the ancient and unfathomable.

Stay vigilant and tread carefully,

- Daniel & Per at The Fine Arc

notes.title: Announcing CTHULHU'S REACH: DEVIL REEF Early Access
notes.content:
[b]Hey there, Adventurer![/b]

It's been quite the odyssey since we embarked on the journey of developing "Cthulhu's Reach: Devil Reef", and it has evolved into the most ambitious and intricate game we've ever crafted. After nearly two years of dedicated work, there's still a world of possibilities we aim to explore: additional weapons, innovative mechanics, fine-tuning gameplay balance, and beyond. Rather than delaying the launch, we've chosen to engage the community in our ongoing development journey by releasing in Early Access, while still aiming for our target release date around Steam Scream 2024.

[b]What to expect[/b]

The game has taken serious steps forward in the last couple of months, but it is not yet as fully featured as we would like it to be. Below is a list of the major features that we are actively working on:

[list]
[*][b]The Acts[/b]
In this Early Access release, you will be able to play a rough version of the first Act. We plan to expand on this going forward and have three Acts fully fleshed out come the full release of the game later this year.

[*][b]Map Editor[/b]
The editor is currently deactivated and only used internally while we develop the game. We aim to make the game’s editor available for players to create their own custom maps and scenarios.

[*][b]Arsenal[/b]
There are currently four playable weapons in this Early Access version of the game. We have planned for the game to have nine distinct weapons upon release. The weapons will range from real-world representations such as flamethrowers and hand grenades to more fantastical Eldritch-imbued weapons.

[*][b]More Horrors[/b]
Enemies of various shapes and sizes will be introduced progressively as the Early Access continues. Expect to see scuttling, drifting, flying, and crawling monsters that try to halt your endeavor.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328413/9bced2cde93d48e8199f3cc47b21806c2aaa3566.png[/img]

The project has thus far thrived and surpassed our expectations, largely thanks to the incredible community support. The invaluable suggestions, feedback, and bug reports from our players have pushed the game forward. We are excited to continue this collaborative spirit, inviting players to join us on this thrilling adventure, crafting an otherworldly action roguelike experience set in the sinister abyss of Devil Reef.

Take the journey with us and we will see you in the depths!

Warm Regards,
The Fine Arc Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328413/ae9311e58acb0e72b535b0ddd42f42d4e4c01191.png[/img]

notes.title: Developer Log Update #2
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, intrepid investigators and daredevils of the unknown![/h1] 

The arcane forces within the eldritch abyss have stirred once again, and we're thrilled to unveil the latest diabolical concoctions in our Lovecraftian action roguelike dungeon crawler - Cthulhu's Reach: Devil Reef.

[u]Version 0.43[/u] delves deeper into the sinister secrets of Devil Reef, introducing gameplay-altering updates that will chill your spine and quicken your heartbeat. Strap in, as we journey through the abyss and unveil the horrors that await.

[h3][b]The Beach Of Innsmouth[/b][/h3]
Choose your starting weapon from your wooden chest on the jetty, initiating your journey with a strategic choice. Then confront your fears and ferry by boat to the reef. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328413/1b072d578313a40a6d3a6c3938ac8ea9f9c05b61.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Mystical Marauders and Devilish Denizens[/b][/h3]
Embark on a perilous odyssey against the enhanced Innsmouth Men and Deep Ones. These aquatic adversaries now possess formidable health, demanding a keen eye and a steady hand to fend them off. 

[h3][b]Psionic Prowess Unleashed[/b][/h3]
A new threat emerges from the abyss - the Psychic Deep One. Armed with otherworldly abilities, this creature can slow you down with its psychic onslaught. Beware the lightning-infused plasma bullets that crackle through the void, a visual and auditory symphony signaling imminent danger. Adjust your tactics and brace yourself for an otherworldly challenge!

[h3][b]Innsmouth Intruders[/b][/h3]
Adding a new layer to the cosmic tapestry, the Innsmouth Man now prowls the accursed corridors of Devil Reef. These grotesque denizens bring fresh terror, enhancing the diversity of foes that lurk in the shadows. Prepare for unexpected encounters as you navigate the eldritch labyrinth.

[h3][b]Ethereal Enchantments[/b][/h3]
Witness the arcane unfold with an overhauled incantation system. Unearth scrolls containing powerful spells, each with its own rarity rating. From critical chance modifications to resisting status effects, the incantation arsenal is enriched. Equip yourself with these mystical powers, for they may be the key to surviving the malevolent depths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328413/e88a21a3a8f201db9e106155f7b428d3fc3ae037.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Sonic Sorcery and Ambient Anomalies[/b][/h3]
Feel your heartbeat as you travel through the abyss with dynamic music adjustments, reflecting the ebb and flow of danger. Upgrade your senses with tweaked ducking settings, ambient light controls, and the introduction of action drums. The audio realm now mirrors the escalating threat levels, immersing you further into the cosmic symphony of Cthulhu's Reach.

[previewyoutube=6HQyMI7JycU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


[h3][b]The Veil Unveiled[/b][/h3]
As we conclude this dev log, the eldritch whispers beckon you to Devil Reef. The dread deepens, and the mysteries multiply. Brace yourself, for Cthulhu's Reach - will you answer the call, or succumb to the abyssal embrace?

Stay vigilant, investigators, for more horrors await in the next dev log. Until then, may the stars guide you through the shadows.


[h4]Join the discussion on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2412200/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url] or dive into the abyss on our [url=https://discord.com/channels/1161192408961273876/1161192409514909759]Discord Server[/url].[/h4]

notes.title: Developer Log Update #1
notes.content:
[h1]Salutations, esteemed Steam dwellers![/h1]

We are delighted to announce the latest developments in 'Cthulhu's Reach: Devil Reef,' our heart-pounding isometric action roguelike set in the Lovecraftian universe. Your participation and feedback during Steam Next Fest have played a crucial role in shaping the game. Here are some of the points that have been improved upon and implemented thanks to your response:

[b]1. Eldritch Encounters Evolve: Enter the Realm of Elder Schools![/b]
We've listened to your wish for a deeper connection between the scrolls and the chilling denizens of the dungeon. In the mid and later stages of the game, monsters can now emerge with an associated elder school, adding a new layer of challenge. To effectively overcome these adversaries, players can strategically employ the gathered scrolls throughout their journey and enhance their powers.

[b]2. Chaos Unleashed: Meet the 1920's Tommy Gun![/b]
Dive into the abyss armed with the 1920's Tommy Gun, a weapon with a roaring and chaotic personality. Experience an adrenaline surge as you unleash an unyielding barrage of bullets, capturing the essence of the adventure that lies ahead.

[b]3. Multiplayer Mayhem: Monsters Multiply in Numbers![/b]
Cooperative chaos has reached new heights. In response to your call for more intense multiplayer experiences, monsters now multiply when more players join the fray. Team up with fellow investigators and face the growing tide of eldritch horrors together.

[b]4. Seamless Combat: Unleash Melee with a Single Button Press![/b]
Combat has reached new levels of fluidity. Say farewell to weapon-switching hassles – now, with a single button press, perform seamless melee attacks, ensuring every encounter is immediate and intense.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328413/f831cc55ae81a4128b40fe97cc116ebdfbbc69b7.png[/img]

[h3]Upcoming Features to Awaken the Dread![/h3]
Beyond these developments, we anticipate the following features on the horizon: 
[list]
[*] Molotov Mayhem: Unlock the ability to strategically throw Molotov grenades, setting the stage ablaze.
[*] Fiery Arsenal: Discover the arrival of a flamethrower in the in-game shop, introducing explosive and fiery chaos.
[*] Strategic Annihilation: Explore new tactical dimensions with exploding barrels and boxes, providing 
inventive ways to vanquish your eldritch adversaries.
[/list]
[h3]Engaging with the Abyss: Beyond Development Highlights[/h3]
We recently had the pleasure of connecting with our community at 'Arctic Game Dev 2023', a local game conference organized by Arctic Game and Global Top Round. These events serve as a source of inspiration, providing valuable opportunities for us to engage with like minded.

[h3]Join the Discussion: Be a Part of the Dark Tapestry![/h3]
Your feedback and insights have been instrumental in shaping 'Cthulhu's Reach: Devil Reef.' We invite you to join our community discussions on the Steam forums or the conversations on our Discord server. 

Thank you for reading!

Regards,
The Fine Arc Team

Join the discussion on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2412200/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url] or dive into the abyss on our [url=https://discord.com/channels/1161192408961273876/1161192409514909759]Discord Server[/url].
